notes: The 'Nor' rests on the waw alone because the second line's negative is gapped (rules 25 and 35); the waw is the only morpheme present to carry the word.

The margin's 'them that destroy' was read and set aside under rule 38; the printed 'that which destroyeth' is a headless-relative recasting whose supplied antecedent and relative join the infinitive's unit under rule 46, the written 'to' staying with the לְ under rule 52.
The assimilated article before 'women' is a real token with no written 'the' beside it (rules 12, 29).
